text:
lara: Heads-up — I'm seeing warmup tokens from model-variant rollouts show up in the per-model burn and it skews our heatmap. Example: tenant=acme-prod, canary -> +18% daily burn, warmup_tokens ~200k. Anyone else? :eyes:

mike: Yup, noticed that yesterday on my canary run. Runtime is priming KV and doing a small prefill which we currently count as normal tokens. We tag them as warmup in telemetry but the console aggregates them into the model bucket.

ash: UX/product ask — can we expose warmup as a separate breakdown and give customers a way to opt out or cap warmup billing for rollouts? Customers keep asking why a canary bumps their reported model cost.

oliver: From runtime side there are two warmup flows: weight/kv prefetch and a small set of synthetic calls we issue to warm caches. We can add a request header `x-redwood-warmup: true` and an attribution id to make it explicit. Should be cheap.

lara: Ideal console behavior: 1) a filter to hide/show warmup tokens in the heatmap 2) a warmup-specific card showing "prefetch / KV priming" costs 3) in the rollout flow show an "estimated warmup cost" preview.

mike: Backend note — our telemetry already emits `warmup_tokens` and `is_warmup` per-invocation, so cost calc can split them. Need to change aggregation pipeline to produce two metrics: model_cost_total and model_cost_excluding_warmup. Also we should surface per-variant warmup impact for rollouts.

ash: UX copy idea for tooltip: "Warmup tokens are system-driven requests (prefetches, KV priming) performed when deploying or routing to a cold variant. These are billable but shown separately to avoid misleading per-model comparisons." Thoughts?

mike: Agree. Quick SQL to preview warmup per variant (proto):
```sql
SELECT variant_id, sum(warmup_tokens) as warmup_tokens, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens
FROM invocation_tokens
WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY variant_id
ORDER BY warmup_tokens DESC;
```
This gives a preview we can plug into the rollout UI.

oliver: Adding header + attribution id is fine. We'll also emit a small sampling flag so we don't double the telemetry volume. Implementation: set `x-redwood-warmup: 1` on prefetch requests and add `warmup_attribution_id` in trace.

cost-bot: Created ticket RW-4820: "warmup cost gating & console breakdown" (assignee: unassigned)

lara: Proposed owners: mike -> backend calc + API, ash -> UX mock + copy, oliver -> runtime headers/traces. I'll file follow-up tasks under RW-4820 and link design/engineering briefs.

mike: Taking backend. ETA: next Thursday for metrics and API param `include_warmup_cost` (default true). Will add a flag for the console preview endpoint: `?include_warmup_cost=false`.

ash: I'll push mock by Thursday EOD. Need signoff from revenue/comms for tooltip wording.

oliver: Runtime change small; target Tue next week for header + sampling. Will coordinate with mike on telemetry schema.

lara: Also note: docs/billing needs a paragraph clarifying warmup is billable but can be viewed separately — mike/ash please coordinate with docs.

mike: noted.

lara: Thanks everyone — I'll update RW-4820 with the owner list and drop the rollout mock link when it's ready. :thumbsup:

lara: Link to ticket (private): https://redwood.internal/ops/RW-4820
